name: BEFAR GROUP CO LTD-H
summary: Befar Group Co., Ltd makes and sells chemicals across three sectors. Chlor-alkali products include sodium hydroxide, propylene oxide, epichlorohydrin, allyl chloride, trichloroethylene and perchloroethylene, and C3-C4 chemicals include methyl tert-butyl ether (MTBE), propane and propylene.
